The movement commands cruise (00E08F70), stop (00E08F88) and moveonpath (00E08F80) fall through to 00817334: msg+21h != 0 takes 0071D880 (clear every slot), else the vtable[34h] gate 00835E90, then 0071ECF0. docs/CRUISE_COMMAND.md | Run-time evidence, bsp_game.exe milestone 2l: 13 calls with flags 1, so each took 0081733e (0071d880, clear every slot) and then 0081735d (0071ecf0); the 00835e90 gate at 0081734b was never reached, because both authored producers push flags 1. name: BSP_UnitPoseHistoryRing_Destruct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_unit_subobjects, read-only analysis. Supersedes the Ghidra symbol CG_adjustor_thunk_00818100: this is not an adjustor thunk. The whole body is three instructions, 00818100 MOV dword ptr [ECX],0xd09480 / 00818106 ADD ECX,0x4 / 00818109 JMP 0x0041cc80, so it restores the unit+BD0h object's own vtable and tail-jumps into BSP_CriticalSection_DestroyOwned with ECX = self+4h. That is the plain destructor of the object BSP_UnitPoseHistoryRing_Construct 00815600 builds, and it is the independent confirmation that +4h is a critical section the object owns. The transfer at 00818109 is a JMP, not a CALL, so it carries no RET of its own. docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_SUBOBJECTS.md

name: BSP_UnitInstance_SetTorpedoStock
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = unit)(int stock). Compares stock with the live count 00810E90; when lower it clears the spare at unit+104Ch and calls 0081DCB0 until the count reaches stock, otherwise it stores stock minus the live count into unit+104Ch. Then it walks the unit's direct children (node+48h, chained through node+44h), and for each that answers vtable[5Ch](20h) and whose weapon descriptor gun[3F4h]+80h is 7, re-arms with 0072D520(gun, barrel, 1) at 0081F95A every barrel whose timer at gun[414h] is at or above the threshold 00D7A278.
